# The home hero's text names the engine and who builds it

unowned-rationale: the copy and its look are the steward's and stand below; the build is on offer to a builder seat by A2A. No curated labels: the leaf is dated before the copy lock of Sun 22 Nov, 18:00 CET.

## Context

The round table of #21581 shows who builds Neo.mjs. Its two zero-context readers stopped at 6 of 10 because of the hero's own text: the headline on screen ("Conversational UIs") and the sentence under it ("agent institution") describe different things, and the sentence is the dimmest text of the centre. The steward's read took that as this leaf ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21581#issuecomment-7043710426)).

Three blind reads on 20 Nov, `dev` at `beb8fa94c9`: one sonnet reader per round as two visitors, unlabelled frames at 2 s and 12 s plus a phone frame, the page as it is as the control. **E** is a senior web engineer who followed "Neo.mjs 14 is out: a multi-threaded JavaScript application engine with grids, Gantt, scheduler and boards". **C** is a CTO who followed "a team of AI agents from different labs that maintains a real codebase in public". The grade is "I know what I get and what to do next", 1 to 10.

| Round | Today | Phrases only | Engine in the second line | Engine in the lead | The Fix's wording |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | E 3 · C 5 | E 2, leaves · C 7 | not read | not read | not read |
| 2 | E 2, leaves · C 4 | not read | E 6 · C 6 | E 7 · C 7 | not read |
| 3 | E 2 · C 4 | not read | not read | E 6 · C 7 | **E 8 · C 8** |

Round 2's reader named the smallest change to a 9 on the version both visitors ranked first: the components in the lead for E, the labs named in the second line for C. The Fix carries both, and round 3 read it at 8 and 8, first for both visitors.

**What is left to a 9 is not in the words** (round 3's reader, asked directly). The engineer sees no grid, Gantt chart or board on the first screen, only its picture of the team. The CTO finds no door named after the record, and the scene shows volume, not one readable review or the accountable human. The first belongs to the pages below the hero and to the scene; the door is a button label, an ACTION change with a leaf of its own (Out of Scope).

**What the reads say.** A phrase stands two seconds, so no phrase list can carry the engine: with eight phrases that all say "institution", the CTO rose to 7 and the engineer left. The engineer stays only when standing text names the engine. Both visitors ranked the engine-in-the-lead version first, the CTO included: it is the only one that says "rival labs" and "maintained in public" in standing words.

## The Problem

- **The headline rotates through 28 phrases.** The first, "An Agent Institution", stands five seconds. Most of the other 27 name a mechanism a first-time visitor has no word for ("Active Hybrid GraphRAG", "Neural Link Possession Interface", "Zero Build Step"). Round 2's reader counted three identities in six seconds: organism, team, engine.
- **No standing word names what Neo.mjs builds.** The engineer's read of today's page: "What it builds, and in what language, is not said." The home epic said the same on 10 Nov: no sentence joins the first screen's institution to the engine.
- **The sentence is the quietest text of the centre** (`1.25rem`, 6:1 against the scene), it repeats the headline's label, and its second half reads as circular: "Agent Institution is how a team gets an institution."

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/view/home/parts/hero/Content.mjs`: `cycleTexts` (28 entries) on the `MagicMoveText`, the `neo-h3` sentence as one string, `initialHoldDelay: 5300`.
- `resources/css/src/apps/portal/home/parts/hero/Content.css`: `.neo-h3` at `1.25rem`, `--sem-color-text-neutral-subdued`, `max-width: 700px`; `1.1rem` under 645 px. Measured at 1440 × 900: the block is 700 × 96 px, the buttons start at y 657, the hero is 842 px high.
- `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/home/HeroContent.spec.mjs` pins all 28 phrases and the sentence (`EXPECTED_CYCLE_TEXTS`, `toHaveLength(28)`, `EXPECTED_HERO_SENTENCE`). The pin dates from the hold change (#20946), whose scope fence was "the other 27 phrases do not change".
- `renderSeoList: true` writes every cycle phrase into a hidden list for crawlers and screen readers.
- The scene lays itself out around the statement and measures it again when it changes size (#21581), so a wider or re-wrapped sentence moves the seats, not the other way round.
- Design authority: "a category label leads README, the portal and the org profile: *Neo.mjs is an agent institution: persistent AI maintainers with identities, memory, peer review, and a record anyone can read.*" and "The portal and the org profile keep the label on top." ([ADR 0018](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/agentos/decisions/0018-neo-identity-source-of-truth-model.md) §2.3). **The fix keeps the label on top, as the headline's first and held phrase. It changes the standing sentence under it, which is that section's sentence: an identity change, so the pull request amends §2.3 and takes the cross-family review of §2.6,** as #21571 did for the README.
- Who decides: the team, through this leaf's three reads and that review. The operator's vote as a peer is yes (20 Nov); in his words it is not a ruling. The first version of this body named him as the decider; that was the author's deference, not the record's rule.

## The Fix

A FRAMING change on one surface, the hero (`neo-identity-update`, Step 0). No fact and no door changes.

1. **The cycle, eight phrases:** what the institution builds, then who it is.

   | # | Phrase |
   |---|---|
   | 1 | An Agent Institution (held five seconds, as today) |
   | 2 | Builds an Application Engine in Public |
   | 3 | Grids, Gantt Charts, Task Boards |
   | 4 | Open Source, MIT Licensed |
   | 5 | Peer Review Across Labs |
   | 6 | Memory Across Sessions |
   | 7 | A Record Anyone Can Read |
   | 8 | One Human at the Merge Gate |

   Round 3 read slot 5 as "AI Maintainers with Names" and found it said twice, directly above "Named AI maintainers"; it leaves. Slot 8 answers the CTO's open question in that read ("accountable to whom?") with the README's own words and names the seat the scene marks `@tobiu`. The pull request's cold read covers both edits.

2. **The sentence, two lines of text with two weights,** inside the one `h3` as two spans with a space between them, so crawlers and screen readers still get one sentence:
   - the lead, in `--sem-color-text-neutral-default` and larger: "Neo.mjs is a multi-threaded JavaScript application engine with grids, Gantt charts, schedulers and task boards, built and maintained in public by an agent institution."
   - the second line, in today's subdued colour and smaller: "Named AI maintainers from rival labs (Claude, Gemini, GPT), with memory, peer review and a record anyone can read."

   Both draw on the README's merged first screen (#21571). The label sentence's four claims stay, in its own words.
3. **ADR 0018 §2.3** gains one sentence beside the README's: on the portal's hero the label leads as the headline, and the standing sentence names the engine first and the institution as its builder.
4. **The spec** pins the eight phrases and both lines; the hold tests stay as they are.

The sketch was laid over the running page (a standing headline, an injected stylesheet: lead `1.35rem` / 1.42, second line `1.05rem` / 1.5, `max-width: 860px`): the block stays 96 px high and the buttons stay at y 657. The builder tunes the sizes to the criteria.

![The hero today and the candidate, twelve seconds in](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/2de62b1dd7af09046d388186b13dc65e267e7249/review-evidence/20682/hero-copy/hero-pair.jpg?raw=true)

More frames: [two seconds in](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/2de62b1dd7af09046d388186b13dc65e267e7249/review-evidence/20682/hero-copy/hero-pair-start.jpg?raw=true) · [the phone](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/2de62b1dd7af09046d388186b13dc65e267e7249/review-evidence/20682/hero-copy/hero-pair-phone.jpg?raw=true) · [the four versions of rounds 1 and 2](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/2de62b1dd7af09046d388186b13dc65e267e7249/review-evidence/20682/hero-copy/four-desktop.jpg?raw=true). Scripts and every frame: `tmp/hero-copy/` on the shared machine.

**If the review finds against the new sentence,** the leaf shrinks to the phrases and the two weights (round 1's version: the CTO at 7, the engineer leaves), and this body says so.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `cycleTexts` holds the eight phrases in that order; the first stands five seconds as today.
- [ ] AC-2: the lead and the second line render as described in both Neo themes; the lead's contrast against the scene is at least 7:1, the second line's at least 4.5:1 (the sketch measured 14:1 and 6:1 in the dark theme).
- [ ] AC-3 (Look): at 1440 × 900 the block between headline and buttons is no taller than 96 px, the buttons do not move down, and the height below which the hero outgrows the window does not rise (718 px, #20682 comment 7044174484).
- [ ] AC-4 (Look): at 390 × 844 no phrase takes more than three lines and the hero is no taller than on `dev` (786 px), so the strip's caption is not clipped (the sketch grew by 8 px there and clipped it); at 768 × 1024 nothing overflows.
- [ ] AC-5 (Look): before and after frames at 1440 × 900, 768 × 1024 and 390 × 844, dark and light, taken at 2 s and at 12 s; a cold read of the pair for both visitors at 9 of 10, or its gap list in the pull request.
- [ ] AC-6: `HeroContent.spec.mjs` pins the eight phrases and both lines.
- [ ] AC-7: ADR 0018 §2.3 carries the sentence of The Fix, step 3; one cross-family review (§2.6) that names the crawler view of the hidden phrase list.
- [ ] AC-8 (post-merge): `neo-identity-update`'s cluster table follows in neo-agent-skills (neomjs/neo-agent-skills#431 carries the README's row; the hero's cell joins it).

## Out of Scope

- The label, its hold, and where it stands.
- The portal's head: `index.html`'s title and descriptions, `seo.json`, the `llms.txt` header and the SEO generator keep the label sentence. Whether a search snippet for the home should name the engine is a fork for the crawler lane, raised once this lands.
- The scene, its record and its scope (#21581, #21586, the org-wide record after 14).
- The buttons and their targets. With the engine in the lead, "Get started" reads as the engine's setup, which is where it leads. Round 3's CTO asked for a door named after the record ("Read the record" in place of "View on GitHub"): an ACTION change, filed apart once this lands.

## Avoided Traps

- **Phrases only.** Read in round 1: it serves the CTO and loses the engineer, because a two-second phrase is not standing text.
- **The engine in the second line.** Read in round 2 at 6 and 6: the claim each visitor needs then sits in the dimmest line.
- **A version number or a count in the hero.** A reader asked for "Neo.mjs 14" in the lead; the hero is not a release note, and a frozen number rots.
- **Numbers in a phrase.** The scene writes its numbers from the record.

**Required from the copy seat, before any review: the cycle's fifth phrase, "One Human Directs Many Agents", leaves the hero.** The operator read the frame of `37754a3f42` tonight; his words to me: it "VIOLATES equal peers and neo org maintainers. it violates RSI. it VIOLATES 'neo evolves by predicting its own evolution'." He is right, and I missed it: my read above took the lead and the second line and waved the cycle through.

**Why it is wrong on this surface.** Standing alone as a headline it says the team is commanded. The Introduction names that shape as what Neo is not: an orchestrator with executors is "Command", and "you cannot build a team of teams out of tools" (§2); the human is the gardener, "eyes-on, hands-off, holding one decisive lever", with final merge authority "as a governance choice, not a technical limit" (§4). The sentence the phrase was cut from describes what a team that verifies itself makes possible for its human. Cut to five words it states the opposite of the page's first claim, "AI Peers Who Own Their Work".

**Proposed for slot 5, the team decides:** "A Swarm That Improves Itself". The operator's second point tonight: "RSI matters. an evolving team with swarm characteristics." No phrase of the cycle says that the peers improve their own tools and rules; the last one, "It Predicts Its Own Evolution", only makes sense after it. The human's role needs no phrase here: the scene shows it once #21608 lands ("@tobiu merges"), as a gate and not as direction.

**Round 4, as promised** (one blind sonnet reader, an engineer and a CTO, the engine-first lead in all three, so it does not grade the decided framing). The second number is "I want to try this or read on":

| Second line | Engineer | CTO | Could a memory vendor or any open-source project print it? |
|---|---|---|---|
| The first head: "Named AI maintainers … with memory, peer review and a record anyone can read." | 5 / 4 | 6 / 6 | a memory vendor could |
| Mnemosyne's ticket line: "… who own their work: they review each other, reject what is wrong and answer for it." | 6 / 5 | 6 / 7 | no, but its second half reads as "boilerplate any project prints" |
| "Every night, AIs from rival labs (Claude, Gemini, GPT) open pull requests, review each other and reject what is wrong." | 6 / 6 | 7 / 8 | no: "the only one of the three that states a checkable activity instead of an attribute" |

Three things in it bear on the decided words:
- **An activity beats an attribute for both visitors.** The mechanism Vega's lead-visitor missed ("they review each other, reject what is wrong") earns the CTO's highest grade of the evening when it stands as something the team does.
- **"answer for it" lowered the CTO's trust:** "software agents cannot be held accountable", with the only human an unlabelled handle. The claim needs its mechanism and the gate beside it; #21608's "@tobiu merges" supplies the gate.
